integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Hyper-realistic cinematic documentary style with a handheld documentary camera texture. A wide establishing shot frames an urban street plaza at dusk, warm golden low-angle sunlight raking from the left across the paved ground, stretching long shadows, fine dust glowing faintly in the backlight. A 22-year-old Asian male street dancer stands slightly forward of center among a loose semicircle of onlookers, his black slightly curly short hair rimmed by the side backlight. On the left, a female passerby in a beige jacket holds a phone horizontally at chest height to film; on the right, a young male passerby in a blue jacket watches with hands in his pockets; two more passersby cross the deep background without joining. The camera holds a static wide shot with a very slight handheld breathing sway, steady. [Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the handheld camera pushes in with medium amplitude at slow speed over about two seconds, focus locked on the dancer, transitioning from wide to a medium shot. The backlight traces his hair; a silver earring on his left ear flashes as his head turns slightly, and a light scar near his brow bone is clearly visible. He wears an oversized black hoodie with the hem of a white T-shirt showing beneath, dark gray cargo pants, a black sports wristband on his right wrist, and white sneakers. He raises his left hand to adjust his cap, fingertips pressing the brim down, then sinks his weight, knees bending slightly, and begins his street dance. [Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the continuous action sequence: the dancer executes a fast spin, hoodie hem and cargo pants flaring with centrifugal force, the white T-shirt hem flashing at his waist; he flows into a low slide, body skimming the ground, white sneakers tracing lines across the pavement and kicking up fine dust; then a one-handed ground rotation, right palm pressing the floor, the black wristband swinging with the turn, legs spread in the air for balance; then he launches into a jump, briefly airborne in the warm light. The camera performs a smooth 180-degree arc shot around him at a speed matched to the action rhythm, moving from front to side to back, with warm ground reflections and onlooker silhouettes forming foreground, midground, and background depth. [Shot 4] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a cinematic reverse shot from behind the shoulder of the young man in the blue jacket, his blue-jacketed shoulder blurred in the foreground while the dancer continues performing center frame, the beige-jacketed woman with her phone visible at one side. The camera then cuts back to a close-up of the dancer's focused face — breathing heavier, chest rising and falling, eyes locked on the ground rhythm — the scar and earring crisp in the warm light. [Shot 5] At 00:08.500, a passerby crosses the foreground and briefly occludes the dancer for about one second, the frame blurring into passing fabric color. When the passerby exits, the dancer is the same person — same black curly short hair, silver earring, light brow scar, black hoodie and white T-shirt hem — seamlessly continuing his routine, gathering power from a low position to jump again. [Shot 6] At 00:10.000, the finale: the dancer completes his final jump, lands with both feet and bends his knees to absorb the impact, coming to a steady stop, chest heaving, arms dropping naturally to his sides. The crowd begins to applaud, clapping growing from scattered to dense; the woman in the beige jacket on the left steps forward, lowering her phone slightly with an appreciative expression. The dusk light deepens to a warmer orange, shadows lengthening further, as the camera holds a slow medium shot on the dancer to close.

overall_soundscape: Low city traffic hum and faint crowd chatter fill the plaza throughout. Sneakers scuff the pavement, fabric swishes through spins, a palm thuds dully against the ground, and low murmurs of amazement rise from onlookers; a passerby's footsteps and clothing brush past the microphone mid-clip before the dance rhythm returns, and the sequence resolves into applause, a few whistles, and evening street ambience.

超写实电影纪录片风格，12秒视频，傍晚城市街头广场，一场临时街舞挑战正在进行。真实城市环境，人群自然活动，具有纪录片摄影质感。
画面核心主体是一名22岁的亚洲男性街舞者，他必须在整个视频中保持完全一致：
黑色微卷短发，左耳佩戴银色耳环，眉骨附近有一道浅色疤痕，穿宽松黑色连帽卫衣，卫衣内露出白色T恤下摆，深灰色工装裤，右手佩戴黑色运动手环，脚穿白色运动鞋。
视频开始：
广角远景展示城市广场环境，核心男性舞者站在人群中央准备表演。周围有3-4名不同身份的路人：
左侧一名穿米色外套的女性拿手机拍摄；
右侧一名穿蓝色夹克的年轻男性观看表演；
后方两名路人经过，但不参与舞蹈。

镜头逐渐推进到核心舞者中景，他调整帽子，然后开始街舞表演。
随后进入连续动作：
核心舞者完成快速旋转、低位滑步、单手撑地旋转和跳跃动作。舞蹈过程中，镜头绕人物进行180度移动，从正面移动到侧面，再移动到背面，展示完整动作。
在动作过程中，加入电影反打镜头：
镜头切换到观看者视角，从蓝色夹克男性路人的肩后拍摄核心舞者表演，前景可以看到路人的肩膀虚化，核心舞者位于画面中央。
随后切回核心舞者近景，展示他的脸部表情和快速动作细节。
中途，一名路人从镜头前经过，短暂遮挡核心舞者约1秒。当路人离开后，核心舞者继续完成动作，必须仍然是同一个人。
最后：
核心舞者完成跳跃动作并停下，人群开始鼓掌，拍摄手机的女性路人向前一步展示反应。
整个视频必须保持：
核心舞者始终是同一个人；
脸部五官、疤痕、发型、耳环完全一致；
黑色卫衣、白色内搭、工装裤、运动鞋保持一致；
路人只能作为背景和互动角色，不得替代核心人物；
镜头切换后核心人物身份不能改变；
遮挡恢复后不能重新生成不同人物；
不增加额外舞者；
不改变人物数量关系。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, high-craft short film in a warm amber-and-brass palette with soft diffused light, inside an old-town watch repair shop: aged wooden shelves line the back wall, a brass desk lamp casts warm key light from the left, and dozens of hanging clocks blur softly in the background bokeh. The camera holds a static extreme close-up, steady, as the tip of a pair of fine steel tweezers rises slowly from the leather work mat, lifting a tiny brass gear into razor-sharp focus, its worn, flattened teeth catching the lamplight. The old master watchmaker, right eye squinting behind a jeweler's loupe strapped to his brow, rotates the gear a few degrees in the tweezers' grip, tilting it toward the lamp as light rakes across his weathered skin. The old master watchmaker with a low, gravelly voice (S1) says: <d>[Chinese]这个齿轮磨损了，得换。</d> [Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of the glass display counter and pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed: a young female customer leans forward over the counter, weight settling onto her forearms, her profile softly lit by the desk lamp whose glow reflects in the crystal glass of the disassembled pocket watch lying open before her — gears, springs, and the exposed movement spread neatly on a dark leather mat. Her eyes trace the watch's inner workings, shifting slightly as she follows the lamplight sliding across the polished steel. The young female customer with a soft, gentle voice (S2) asks: <d>[Chinese]还能修好吗？</d> [Shot 3] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to an extreme close-up of the watch face, static and steady: the master's hands lower the tweezers and seat the tiny gear back into the movement with a faint metallic click, then swing the engraved cover closed with a soft, controlled press of his thumb. The second hand shudders, catches, and begins to sweep smoothly around the dial, each tick crisp against the engraved minute markers as the lamplight glints off the dial glass with every passing marker. The master leans back slightly, a warm smile spreading across his softly lit face as the old master watchmaker (S1) says: <d>[Chinese]好了，走得比原来还准。</d> The second hand completes its first full arc while the light settles on the polished case. Throughout: sharp focus on gear edges, dial markers, tweezers tip, and skin texture; no on-screen text, no watermarks, no extra people, and only one distinct face per shot.

overall_soundscape: The layered ticking of many clocks rises and falls at mixed tempos under a faint old-town room hum. Fine tweezers click faintly, a tiny gear snaps into the movement with a metallic click, the watch cover closes with a soft press, and the second hand's ticking becomes crisp and steady.

non_diegetic_music: A gentle, unhurried piano enters with sparse single notes and soft sustain at a slow tempo, resolving on a final warm chord as the video ends.
original_prompt:
总时长严格为12秒；画面比例固定为16:9横屏；沿用正文三个4秒分镜。0:00-0:04背景，老城区修表铺。画面，老师傅右眼夹着单片放大镜，用镊子夹起一枚细小齿轮，神情专注。 台词动作，老师傅（低声）：“这个齿轮磨损了，得换。” 运镜，固定。机位，特写，镊子尖与齿轮。BGM和音效，钟表此起彼伏的滴答声。

0:04-0:08 背景，修表铺玻璃柜台。画面，年轻女顾客俯身看着柜台上拆开的怀表，表盘玻璃反射台灯的光。 台词动作，女顾客（好奇）：“还能修好吗？” 运镜，慢推。机位，近景，女顾客侧脸与怀表。BGM和音效，加入轻柔钢琴。
0:08-0:12背景，修表铺玻璃柜台。画面，老师傅把齿轮装回机芯，合上表盖，怀表秒针重新走动。 台词动作，老师傅（微笑）：“好了，走得比原来还准。” 运镜，切镜头。机位，大特写，秒针与表盘刻度。BGM和音效，滴答声变清晰，音乐温和收尾.视频中不要加字幕，视频中的音频一定要用纯中文发音，同一个视频镜头内不要有相同面孔的人物。镜头稳定，画面清晰锐利，齿轮边缘、表盘刻度、镊子尖与人物皮肤纹理清楚可辨，主体造型保持稳定不变，角色面部不扭曲，物体结构不崩坏，光影柔和，氛围连贯，电影感运镜，细节细腻，高质感短片。负面提示词： 畸形，扭曲，多肢体，崩坏，模糊，失焦，水印，文字，logo，杂乱物体，人脸变形，多余人物，低清晰度，画面抖动过度，错误透视。
